The project received CA$ 3,373 from 78 backers on Kickstarter.
The funding goal for the Hermes project was CA$ 500.

fact_previews: The software Eudora has been revived and re-christened Hermes.
Nicholas Edward Werner-Matavka is leading the development of Hermes.
A talented team of C++ programmers is working on the development of Hermes.
Legal encumbrances prevented the use of the Eudora name for the revived software.
Hermes includes features such as updated SpamWatch definitions and ultra-fast indexed search.

fact_previews: Hermes is a project that aims to deliver a next-generation email client, originally known as Eudora.
The project is led by Nicholas Edward Werner-Matavka.
Hermes will have versions for Mac and Linux, supporting all major computing platforms.
The Hermes project depends on a customized user interface toolkit known as RogueWave Stingray.
RogueWave Stingray is commercial software and cannot be distributed with the source code.

The project aims to replace the unsolicited mail filter with a Bayesian alternative, such as SpamAssassin or Bogofilter.

The project requires the QCSSL dll for Eudora to communicate with modern SSL servers.
